occurrences.englishText: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol,† Sheol is the place of the dead.
Yes, he would have allured you out of distress,
If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man,
Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.
The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
